name: Symbiosis International (Deemed University)
description: Symbiosis International includes constituent institutes with separate programmes and admissions. The MBA listed here is the two-year residential programme at Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune.

source.title: SIBM Pune MBA fee structure 2026–28
source.notes: Indian students, SIBM Pune MBA batch 2026–28: academic fees total ₹13,10,000 per year, paid as two ₹6,55,000 instalments. The document does not separate tuition, so this amount is not imported as tuition. First-year three-sharing hostel is ₹1,57,300; mess is ₹1,19,600 across two instalments; refundable institute and hostel deposits total ₹40,000. First-year listed payments total ₹16,26,900, before any applicable government taxes. Later hostel/mess fees will be announced and can increase by up to 15%; no fixed full-course living-cost total is inferred.
